parameters.toolDescription:
Fetch live public page content from the company's WordPress website using its public WordPress REST API.

Use this tool only when the customer asks for information that is not already available in the company context, such as detailed services, pricing, FAQs, policies, company information, or website page content.

This tool retrieves live information directly from the company's approved website.

The URL must belong to the company's website/domain. Do not fetch unrelated websites or external domains.

Use the returned website content as the source of truth for information that is not available in the company context. Do not invent or assume information that is not present in the returned website content.
